title: A closed curve from rotating circles
lede: The curve (gray) is sampled and its discrete Fourier transform is computed. The N largest terms become circles: each rolls at a whole-number speed, and the tip of the chain traces the teal curve.
notice: With a few circles the tip draws a smooth blob. Each added circle is smaller and faster and adds finer detail.
The corners of the square wave and the star need many circles, and the approximation overshoots near the corners. The heart is smooth, so a few circles already come close.
The distance readout is computed from the curve: it falls as N rises and reaches zero when every sample point is matched.
hint: Raise N to add circles. Pause to read the chain, or switch the curve.
